title: October 2026 — 29-Gallon Aquarium R&D Journal
body: October documented a 30-day maintenance interval with nitrate remaining around 5–10 ppm, a developing betta health concern, preventive water changes, return-side plumbing maintenance, and new lighting experiments. The month also established priorities for November's water-chemistry and distilled-water top-off research.
quick_facts: October 26 preventive water change: approximately 50% display and essentially 100% sump; Prime and Stability used; 30 days since September 26; top-off: 23 containers documented; temperatures: 77.2°F, 77°F, 76.4°F and 76.4°F; October 27 Thrive S: 4 pumps; betta health monitored, facial growth undiagnosed; no new livestock purchases recorded; Blue Diamond shrimp retained, surviving count unknown
nitrate_ppm: October 10: approximately 5–10 ppm; October 15: approximately 10 ppm; October 20: approximately 5–10 ppm; October 26: approximately 5–10 ppm before water change; October 30: approximately 5 ppm or lower
